company.shortDescription: Fifreedomtoday is the #1 Arabic financial media with 1.9+ M followers & 90M+ monthly views, reshaping how Arabs understand money.
company.description:
FiFreedomToday is the premier Arabic digital media platform for financial literacy, fintech, and Web3, commanding a massive audience of 1.9M followers and over 90M monthly organic views.

We leverage this influence through two primary pillars:

* Financial Hero Academy: Our dedicated training arm that transforms digital engagement into real-world impact. Through workshops and bootcamps with global partners, we empower Arabs to achieve lasting financial independence.

* CashTalk Podcast: Our flagship economic show, hosted by Dr. Mahmoud Al Burai. Within 30 days of launch, CashTalk dominated regional charts, ranking Top 5 in Kuwait, Top 10 in Qatar, and Top 50 in the UAE Business category.
